name: M3_PPS100MI_LstAgrLine
description: List agreement lines for a specific supplier and agreement number. Use this operation to view the full content of a purchase agreement at line level.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number for the agreement line.

inputParameters.name: AGNB
inputParameters.description: Agreement number to which this line belongs.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which agreement lines are listed.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the agreement line.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number to which this line belongs.

outputParameters.name: GRPI
outputParameters.description: Group identity that defines the key combination on which the prices and conditions of this agreement line are based.

outputParameters.name: OBV1
outputParameters.description: Primary start value in the group identity that, together with the group identity, identifies this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: OBV2
outputParameters.description: Second start value in the group identity that further specifies this agreement line when used.

outputParameters.name: OBV3
outputParameters.description: Third start value in the group identity that further specifies this agreement line when used.

outputParameters.name: OBV4
outputParameters.description: Fourth start value in the group identity that further specifies this agreement line when used.

outputParameters.name: FVDT
outputParameters.description: Date from which this agreement line is valid.

outputParameters.name: UVDT
outputParameters.description: Date until which this agreement line is valid.

outputParameters.name: SAGL
outputParameters.description: Status of the agreement line, such as active, inactive, or fulfilled.

outputParameters.name: SUPR
outputParameters.description: Setup price defined for this agreement line that can be added to purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: PUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price to apply for this agreement line at the specified quantity break.

outputParameters.name: AGQT
outputParameters.description: Agreed quantity defined for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated quantity purchased against this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PAAM
outputParameters.description: Total amount purchased on this agreement line in the agreement currency.

outputParameters.name: ORCO
outputParameters.description: Country of origin of the item on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Standard purchase order unit of measure used for quantities on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Agreed quantity for this line expressed in the item's basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: UNMS
outputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure in which inventory for the item on this agreement line is maintained.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency code used for prices and amounts on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: SAAM
outputParameters.description: Total amount purchased on this agreement line expressed in local currency.

outputParameters.name: LOCD
outputParameters.description: Local currency code used to express local amounts for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: DEFD
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time days allowed for this agreement line before detention charges are calculated.

outputParameters.name: DEFH
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time hours allowed for this agreement line before detention charges are calculated.

outputParameters.name: DEFM
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time minutes allowed for this agreement line before detention charges are calculated.

outputParameters.name: SEQN
outputParameters.description: Sequence number identifying the agreement line within the agreement.

outputParameters.name: WSCA
outputParameters.description: Subcontracting costing model used to calculate costs for the item on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity to which the purchase price on this agreement line applies.

outputParameters.name: DIP3
outputParameters.description: Third discount used when calculating the net purchase price for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PTCD
outputParameters.description: Code for the text printed instead of the purchase price on purchase documents for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price on this agreement line is expressed.

outputParameters.name: PUU1
outputParameters.description: Purchase order quantity unit of measure defined in the agreement for this line.

outputParameters.name: PPU1
outputParameters.description: Purchase price unit of measure defined in the agreement for this line.

outputParameters.name: POR2
outputParameters.description: Previously used purchase organization identifier for this agreement line (deprecated).

outputParameters.name: RDUR
outputParameters.description: Rental duration associated with this agreement line for X-hire purchase agreements.

outputParameters.name: IFIE
outputParameters.description: Flag indicating whether this agreement line is connected to an interface item that does not yet exist in the item master.

outputParameters.name: PORG
outputParameters.description: Purchase organization that defines which warehouses or planning entities may use this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: SRGR
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether this agreement line contributes to supplier rebate generating or paying totals.
